title: Children speech recording (English spontaneous speech + pre-defined sentences)
why_promising: Primary non-singing child speech with spontaneous and prompted production. The Zenodo record states that the free-speech recordings include manual utterance segmentation, and exposes a 607.5 MB archive (english_children.zip; MD5 1a4fd6116554593324a0a493e44a1eea). This is potentially admissible for utterance-level production timing and acoustic work if the manual segmentation files can be isolated.
open_question: Enumerate the ZIP and confirm annotation format, segmentation granularity, speaker/recording metadata, license, and whether the manually segmented free-speech subset can be separated cleanly from any unannotated material before core admission.
